Handles the console dialogue for buying and selling land, feeding the population and planting crops.
KaiserEngine - Class in de.aikiit.game.kaiser
Maintains the city's population, land, grain stocks and reign statistics, and applies the rules from KAISER.BAS (09.08.1992) without performing console I/O.
